basic_info.description: It's said that beauty's only skin deep, but what you'll love most about this home, isn't just the design-forward updates. Well-proportioned rooms, inviting outdoor spaces to live & lounge, exceptional privacy, & a fantastic Glen Park location, just two blocks from Chenery Street destinations, will keep you feeling the love, each time you pull in the drive. Inside, you'll find a main entry featuring sleek oak casework. A skylit staircase ascends to a central foyer on the main level, which lives large, thanks to a pleasing circular flow, & direct access to a pretty fantastic outdoor area. Two sets of 6 pane casement windows invite lots of light into the living room & dining area. The kitchen is smartly configured & well-equipped. Quartz composite counter surfaces, newly enameled hardwood cabinetry & casework with display shelving make the heart of this home as beautiful as it is functional. The bedrooms each have direct access to the rear deck & garden areas. A skylit bath completes this level. Downstairs is a main bedroom suite with dreamy bath clad in marble & Fireclay tile. Beautifully fitted office alcove & laundry facilities complete the lower level. Gratuitous spending on systems & smart tech updates. You really should put this home on top of your list. See it!
